en.headline: Kwai Chung slope becomes rat haven as departments step up control
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has received three complaints this year about rats on a slope near Tai Lung Street Rest Garden, and joined the Leisure and Cultural Services Department in inspections on…
body: Residents and media reported numerous rats active on a slope below Tai Lung Street Rest Garden in Kwai Chung, with videos showing multiple rodents running through grass and soil.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it had received three complaints about rat activity on the slope so far this year and had referred them to the managing department. On Friday, at the request of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, FEHD officers inspected the site and provided technical advice on control measures.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said it had strengthened cleaning and rodent control at the garden and would arrange specialist contractors to address burrows, hiding places and food sources. Immediate steps included placing more traps and bait boxes and clearing access routes.
FEHD noted that rats are not confined by site boundaries and that effective control requires ongoing source management of waste, food and harbourage by the responsible departments.

zh.headline: 葵涌大隴街斜坡現鼠患 部門加強防治
zh.dek: 食環署今年接獲 3 宗相關投訴，周五應康文署要求到場視察並提供技術意見。
body: 街坊及傳媒近日報道，葵涌大隴街休憩花園下方斜坡有多隻老鼠出沒，影片顯示鼠群在草叢及泥土間活動。
食物環境衛生署表示，今年至今接獲 3 宗有關該斜坡鼠蹤的投訴，已轉介場地管理部門跟進。周五應康樂及文化事務署要求，食環署派員到場視察，並就防治工作提供技術意見。
康文署稱已加強園內清潔及滅鼠工作，並會安排專業承辦商處理鼠洞、藏匿環境及食物來源。即時措施包括增加放置捕鼠器及鼠藥餌盒，以及清除來往通道。
食環署指老鼠不受場地界線限制，有效防治需各場地管理者持續做好源頭治理，妥善處理垃圾、食物來源及藏匿環境。
